answer: Randomized jury audits: each answer is graded by agents drawn at random, and a hidden ivory 'gold' sample with a known score is mixed into every spiral of rounds. Sybils that rubber-stamp each other miss the gold items, so their grading weight is slashed and their stake burned. Faking a cluster atop a quiet knoll of fake IDs costs the attacker real stake per identity plus losses each time one is caught.
